Likewise, the magnitude of these uniform changes was also very similar (7.9% in rats and 7.3% in humans; quantitative agreement).",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "The study was limited to pre- and post-exercise sampling points, potentially missing maximal responses in some variables that peak at later time points.",
    "Anesthetics, including ether, may affect some measured variables, although the study aimed to minimize this effect.",
    "The use of inbred rats might lead to less variability compared to outbred rats, potentially affecting the generalizability of findings."

    "Maximal running velocity achieved in the incremental test: 3.75 ± 0.91 km/h for rats and 15.5 ± 1.8 km/h for humans.",

    "Postexercise plasma volume was 98 ± 3% of pre-exercise plasma volume for rats and 99 ± 5% for humans.",
    "26/30 biochemical parameters changed toward the same direction after exercise in rats and humans (qualitative agreement).",
    "Magnitude of uniform changes in blood biochemical parameters: 7.9% in rats and 7.3% in humans (quantitative agreement).",

    "15/30 parameters had a significant main effect of exercise.",

    "Resting triacylglycerol concentration: 204 mg/dL in rats vs. 140 mg/dL in humans.",
